distinctions.reference_functional_group: Reusable domain of expertise and responsibility; not a mandated department.
distinctions.business_functional_group: The actual business-specific group responsible for one or more domains.
distinctions.task_force: Named working group with domain experts and delegated responsibilities for specified workflows. May span functional groups, be enduring or be time bounded.
distinctions.org_chart: Reporting and management relationships; informs authority but does not define workflow membership.
distinctions.system: Supporting application, machine or technology; represented in Systemverse and linked to workflows.
distinctions.workflow: The work that crosses domains, people, agents, data and systems; ownership is explicit per workflow or decision.

configuration_rules: Preserve stable reference IDs. Map a company group to one or more reference groups and a reference group to multiple company groups as needed.
Record applicable, combined, split, outsourced or not applicable for every reference group, with an explanation.
The reference count is not a required number of departments, task forces or people.
People and agents contribute throughout. Named humans retain authority, risk acceptance and outcome accountability.
Assign domain decision rights to task forces explicitly; membership does not confer approval authority.
A workflow may have multiple contributing groups. Name its accountable human owner and decision owners to avoid ambiguous collective accountability.
Connect task forces to requirements, tests, SOPs, readiness, acceptance, daily operation and improvement.
Industry overlays define applicable obligations and specialist task forces; they do not replace the reference model.
A process flow is not a functional group. Six process constellations cross the hive; a domain can contribute to multiple flows.

regulated_manufacturing: Product safety and sanitation where applicable
food_and_beverage: Applicable FDA and TTB obligations assessed by the business
GMP practices and applicable SQF requirements, distinguished from statutory obligations
other_manufacturing: Configure sector-specific product safety, quality and regulatory requirements

presentation_rule: Public Beehive shows 12 primary groups. The 26 FG domains remain the detailed reference. Actual company groups and task forces are configured separately.
public_mapping_notes: FG-26 spans People & Organization for adoption and Technology & Transformation for operational improvement. This is an intentional shared mapping, not duplicate ownership.
Public grouping is a navigation and communication layer, not a required org chart or task-force count.
